hero.title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
hero.description: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.
